featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with Slick Weddings was deeply disappointing. While there were a few delays from our end due to my mother's health, my husband and I genuinely didn't have the emotional bandwidth to sort through photos while we were dealing with bigger issues. What we faced from their side was far worse.

They missed every timeline promised in the contract. The teaser didn’t come in a month. Photos and videos were delayed for months. When we raised concerns, instead of understanding or professionalism, we were spoken to rudely and dismissively. They even threatened to stop work entirely unless we rushed to meet their sudden deadlines, despite their own repeated failures.

A wedding is deeply personal. You trust someone to help you preserve memories. But we felt ignored, blamed and disrespected. I wouldn’t wish this experience on any couple.

featured_reviews.review_text:

There were repeated delays in delivering the promised photos and videos. Despite a clearly agreed timeline, we had to wait well beyond the committed window, and even then, what was delivered lacked completeness and quality. Some files couldn’t be opened, and when we raised this, the support was minimal and vague.

The communication also became uncomfortable at times. We found references to individuals outside the agreement — including our family members — to be inappropriate and unprofessional. This added an emotional burden to an already delayed process.

Ultimately, we expected a collaborative and respectful relationship, especially for something as personal as a wedding. That wasn’t our experience, and it’s something we’d advise others to be mindful of when choosing a vendor.
